name: collegium
description: Hands a task to another coding agent, such as OpenAI Codex, while you keep working, and brings back its answer with the assumptions and open questions it had. Codex is off until you turn it on, because each run sends your code to OpenAI.

codex.title: Codex
codex.description: Let Collegium run tasks on OpenAI Codex. Turning it on sends the task and the code Codex reads to OpenAI.
